# Spatial Analysis

## NYPD Precincts

```{r create map of nypd precincts}

# plot the NYPD map
nypdMAP <- ggplot(nypd_sf) +
  geom_sf(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  theme_void()

```

## NYC's Five Boroughs

![](../images/clipboard-1679408522.png)

> “\[The above\] figure presents a map of the study area broken down by precinct and bolstered by areas of racial and ethnic dominance based on census figures indicating residential percentages greater than 70 percent for the Hispanic, non-Hispanic black, and non-Hispanic white populations.” ([Newberry, 2017, p. 313](zotero://select/library/items/3GQF23RV)) ([pdf](zotero://open-pdf/library/items/ZD4QYXA7?page=7&annotation=FVYBVE4H))

```{r map of NYC, precints and residential dominance}}

# NYC Precinct Distribution
# NYC map with Precincts and Boroughs
# with Boro lines and precint overlays, including the number of the precinct
pct_bounds <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = nypd_sf, fill = NA, color = "grey70", size = 0.8) +
    geom_sf(data = nyc_sf, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) + 
  geom_sf_text(data = nypd_sf, aes(label = Precinct), size = 1.75, color = "blue") +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, family = "sans"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5, family = "sans")
  )
  

# NYC Residential Dominance
# NYC map with precinct boundaries and Census Tracts
# Color census tract wherein one BWH makes up 70 percent of the population
p1 <- nyc_census2020_trc |>
  select(!c("american_indian_alone","asian_alone", "pacific_islander_alone", "population_one_race", "some_other_race_alone", "two_or_more_races")) |>
  mutate(
    white_share = white_alone / total_population,
    black_share = black_alone / total_population,
    hisp_share  = hispanic_or_latino / total_population,
    
    prod_group = case_when(
      white_share >= 0.65 ~ "Predominantly White",
      black_share >= 0.65 ~ "Predominantly Black",
      hisp_share  >= 0.65 ~ "Predominantly Hispanic",
      TRUE ~ "No Predominant Group"
    ))
  
p1 <- st_transform(p1, st_crs(nyc_sf))
p1 <- st_intersection(p1, nyc_sf)
  
m1 <-  p1 |> ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = prod_group), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Predominantly White" = "greenyellow",
      "Predominantly Black" = "dodgerblue",
      "Predominantly Hispanic" = "darkorange",
      "No Predominant Group" = "white"
    ),
    name = "Majority Group"
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = nyc_sf, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) + 
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = 'inside', 
        legend.justification = c(0.1, 0.9),
        legend.direction = 'vertical',
        legend.title.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

m1

```

## Disparity in Stops across Precincts

```{r precinct-level stop measures, 2024}

# yearly stop totals, by precinct
sqf_hist |>
  group_by(STOP_LOCATION_PRECINCT, YEAR2) |>
  count() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = YEAR2, values_from = n, names_prefix = "stops_")

# initialize new df for precinct-level measures
pct_measures <- nypd_sf |>
  select(Precinct) |>
  mutate(Precinct = as.double(Precinct))

# 2024 stop totals, by precinct
stop_totals_2024 <- sqf_hist |>
  filter(YEAR2 == 2024) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(STOP_LOCATION_PRECINCT) |>
  summarize(totalStops = n())

pct_measures <- pct_measures |>
  left_join(stop_totals_2024,
            by = c("Precinct" = "STOP_LOCATION_PRECINCT"))

# 2024 stop racial breakdown, by precinct
race_breakdown_2024 <- sqf_hist |>
  filter(YEAR2 == 2024,
         SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION %in% BWH) |>
  group_by(STOP_LOCATION_PRECINCT, SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION, values_from = count, names_prefix = "stops")

pct_measures <- pct_measures |>
  left_join(race_breakdown_2024, 
            by = c("Precinct" = "STOP_LOCATION_PRECINCT"))

# 2024 stop racial proportions, by precinct
pct_measures <- pct_measures |>
  mutate(
    stopPropBlack = round(stopsBLACK / totalStops, 2),
    stopPropWhite = round(stopsWHITE / totalStops, 2),
    stopPropHisp  = round(stopsHISPANIC / totalStops, 2),
  )

# join 2020 census pct data to precinct measures
pct_measures <- pct_measures |>
  left_join(
    nyc_census2020_pct |>
      select(precinct, total_population,
             black_alone, white_alone, hispanic_or_latino,
             black_prop, white_prop, hisp_prop) |>
      rename(popBlack = black_alone,
             popWhite = white_alone,
             popHisp  = hispanic_or_latino,
             popPropBlack = black_prop,
             popPropWhite = white_prop,
             popPropHisp  = hisp_prop,
             Precinct = precinct),
    by = "Precinct"
  )


```

# Stop Disparity

```{r black stop disparity}

# calculate stop/population disparity for Blacks, by precinct 
pct_measures$stopDisparityBlack <- pct_measures$stopPropBlack - pct_measures$popPropBlack

# fit linear model
model <- lm(stopPropBlack ~ popPropBlack, data = pct_measures)
r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
r2_label <- paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 3))

# plot stop disparity
stopDisparityPlot <- ggplot(pct_measures, aes(x = popPropBlack, y = stopPropBlack)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = totalStops, color = stopDisparityBlack)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = max(pct_measures$stopPropBlack), label = r2_label, hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    # title = "Proportion of Black Stops vs. Black Population",
    x = "Proportion of Black Population",
    y = "Proportion of Stops Involving Black Individuals",
    color = "Disparity",
    size = "Total Number of Stops"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 

# one-sided proportion test for stop disparity in first precinct
prop.test(x = c(pct_measures$stopsBLACK[1], pct_measures$popBlack[1]),
          n = c(pct_measures$totalStops[1], pct_measures$total_population[1]),
          alternative = "greater",
          conf.level = 0.95
)

# repeat proportion test for all precincts
stopDisparityZtest <- pct_measures |>
  rowwise() |> # for each row (precinct)
  # conduct the prop test if data is available and assign to new column
  mutate(prop_test_result = list(if (!is.na(stopsBLACK) && !is.na(popBlack) &&
                                      totalStops > 0 && total_population > 0) 
                                  { 
                                    prop.test(x = c(stopsBLACK, popBlack),
                                              n = c(totalStops, total_population),
                                              alternative = "greater",
                                              conf.level = 0.95)
                                  } 
                                  else { NA }
                                  )
         ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(prop_test_result)) |>
  select(Precinct, prop_test_result) |>
  mutate(tidy_result = map(prop_test_result, broom::tidy)) |>
  unnest(tidy_result)


```

## Stop disparity for Black individuals: Hypothesis Testing

`stopDisparityZtest`

The two-proportion z-test statistic is calculated as:

$$
z = \frac{\hat{p}_1 - \hat{p}_2}{\sqrt{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})(\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2})}}
$$

Each row = 1 precinct Each column = a result from the two-sample proportion test comparing: $\frac{stopsBLACK}{totalStops}$ vs. $\frac{popBlack}{total_population}$

| Column | Meaning |
|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| `estimate1` | Proportion of Black stops |
| `estimate2` | Proportion of Black residents (population) |
| `statistic` | Chi-square test statistic |
| `p.value` | Probability the observed difference is due to chance |
| `conf.low` / `conf.high` | Confidence interval of difference between proportions |
| `method` | “2-sample test for equality of proportions” |
| `alternative` | Type of test (two-sided by default) |

Is the proportion of stops involving Black individuals significantly different from their share of the population in that precinct?

```{r measuring precinct-level stop disparity}

ggplot(pct_measures) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = stopDisparityBlack)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = unit(5, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "Stop Disparity"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', 
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.direction = 'horizontal',
        legend.title.position = "top")

```

```{r top 10 disparate precincts}

# slice 10 most stop disparate precincts
top10disparatePrecincts <- pct_measures |>
  arrange(desc(stopDisparityBlack)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  select(!geometry)

```

# Boundary Shootings

```{r identify boundary shootings}

#-----------------------------
# 1. Identify state plane rows
#-----------------------------
is_stateplane <- shooting_hist$X_COORD_CD > 500

df_stateplane <- shooting_hist |>
  filter(is_stateplane) |>
  filter(PERP_RACE %in% BWH)

#-----------------------------
# 2. Convert lat/long points to sf (EPSG:2263)
#-----------------------------
pts_stateplane <- st_as_sf(
  df_stateplane,
  coords = c("X_COORD_CD", "Y_COORD_CD"),
  crs = 2263
  )

#-----------------------------
# 3. Transform NYPD polygons to same CRS
#-----------------------------
nypd_sf_2263 <- st_transform(nypd_sf, 2263)

# Extract NYPD boundary
nypd_boundary <- st_boundary(nypd_sf_2263)

# Points within 10 feet of boundary
near_boundary <- st_is_within_distance(
  pts_stateplane,
  nypd_boundary,
  dist = 10,
  sparse = FALSE
)

boundary_points <- pts_stateplane[apply(near_boundary, 1, any), ]

#-----------------------------
# 5. Result
#-----------------------------
boundary_points

boundary_points <- boundary_points |>
  mutate(YEAR = year(OCCUR_DATE),
         MONTH = month(OCCUR_DATE),
         DAY = day(OCCUR_DATE))

nypd_boundary |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(color = "black", fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_points, color = "red", size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r boundary shooting count tables}

# boundary shooting count table, by year AND precinct
boundary_points |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(YEAR, PRECINCT) |>
  count() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = YEAR, values_from = n, names_prefix = "shoot_")

# boundary shooting count table, by year AND race
boundary_points |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(YEAR, PERP_RACE) |>
  count() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = YEAR, values_from = n, names_prefix = "shoot_")

```

```{r filter boundary shootings for 2024}

boundary_points_2024 <- boundary_points |>
  filter(YEAR == 2024)

boundary_points_2024 |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(INCIDENT_KEY, OCCUR_DATE, OCCUR_TIME, PRECINCT, PERP_RACE)
  
```
